description: zizmor CI/nightly boot-and-test profile (req-plugin-extdev-repo-ci; consumed by tap's plugin-ci.yml boot-and-test job). Installs zizmor EDITABLE from the CI checkout at _external/zizmor so the in-package suite runs against THIS repo's HEAD, plus its declared dependency github_core and github_core's own dependency identity_core, both pinned by COMMIT (a tag can be moved; this profile makes code execute inside a job that holds TAP_CORE_RO_PAT). No population section yet: the plugin ships no GRIFT and no collector at this stage (skeleton, zizmor-tap#1). When req-zizmor-record lands, this record gains the corpus seed and a fire-collector step for zizmor:zizmor WITHOUT required_secrets — the offline collector needs none, which makes it the first boot-and-test record in the estate whose collector actually fires in CI. NO profile_kind: it is an allowlist token that only ever widens, and a CI profile has no use for the dev_local affordance.

plugins.note: Package-mode (tap_plugin.identity_core). github_core's declared dependency (oidc_issuer convergence node). Pinned to the commit v0.1.1 pointed at on 2026-08-28.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.github_core). zizmor's declared depends_on: the workflow vocabulary (GithubWorkflow.configuration.raw_yaml, WorkflowJob) the collector reads and the edge endpoints it resolves. Pinned to the commit v0.4.0 pointed at on 2026-09-02. Installed, not seeded, not fired.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.zizmor), installed EDITABLE from the CI checkout so the in-package suite runs against this repo's HEAD. Pulls the exact zizmor==1.30.0 PyPI wheel (the scanner binary) as its Tier-0 dependency.
